hero.headline: Immersive training, taught by working professionals
hero.subheadline: Complete courses you follow remotely, real-world practice, and human support at the centre in Tanger. You move at your own pace, and never on your own.

method.title: Our immersive method
method.subtitle: Four principles that make the difference between following a course and actually being able to do the job.

featured.title: Featured courses
featured.subtitle: A selection of our most requested courses, updated every month.

paths.title: Learning paths
paths.subtitle: Courses arranged in the right order, all the way to the certificate, at a bundle price.

step1.title: Create your account
step1.body: A few details are enough: name, email address and phone number. You then confirm your address.

step2.title: Your account is approved by our team
step2.body: We check your details and activate your account, usually within 24 business hours.

step3.title: Choose your course and send your receipt
step3.body: Pay by bank transfer or in cash at the centre, then upload your transfer receipt from your account area.

step4.title: Access granted, you start learning
step4.body: As soon as the payment is verified, the course opens: videos, resources, quizzes and progress tracking.

pricing.title: A fair price, no surprises
pricing.subtitle: Compare it with what an equivalent in-person course costs. Everything is included: resources, certificate, support and live sessions.

finalCta.title: Start your training today
finalCta.body: Create your account in two minutes. Our team approves it within 24 business hours and helps you choose the right course.

landing.title: The Centre de Formation Immersive platform is taking shape.
landing.tagline: The technical groundwork is in place: four languages, light and dark themes, a component library and the data model. The courses come next.
landing.showcaseHint: Tokens, components and states, in both themes and all four languages.

pending.body: Thank you for registering. Our team is checking your details and approves every account manually, usually within 24 business hours. You will receive an email as soon as your account is activated.
